overview: Two young women–one an overworked manga artist, the other a complete slacker–try to escape the realities of adult responsibilities. Whether it's running off on a day trip instead of being productive or going into debt for an epic meal, the two always have fun when they're together! Enjoy this delightful (and relatable) slice-of-life tale about the little pleasures in ducking away from the hard stuff.
title: Futari Escape

overview: Mu Yunqing and his wife Yu Yingwan are killed while protecting the City Lord's Token. Yu Yingwan awakens to find herself reborn, only to face her husband's intense aversion. Determined to uncover the true mastermind, she remains in the City Lord's mansion, skillfully countering every scheme. But she soon discovers that Mu Yunqing has also been reborn. With the hidden antagonist lying in wait, can the two rewrite their destinies...
title: Beyond The Loop
Love me or leave me. Kochaj albo rzuć

overview: Talking Telephone Numbers was a British game show that was produced by Celador and Carlton and aired on ITV from 28 February 1994 to 22 December 1997. It was originally hosted by Phillip Schofield and Emma Forbes, and later by Claudia Winkleman. The programme featured five games, each designed to generate a number. These numbers were combined towards the end of the programme to form a five-digit code. Viewers with telephone numbers where the last 5 digits matched the code could then phone in to try to win a cash prize.
title: Talking Telephone Numbers

overview: Chronicling the trades and commodities that made America an industrial power: coal, shipbuilding, brewing, textiles and steel. Also: profiles of magnates such as Andrew Carnegie and Henry Kaiser.
title: Empires of Industry

overview: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa. Linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.
title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa

overview: Gonzalo, a bar owner's son, keeps failing at nightlife ventures funded by his father. Given one last chance with a new space, he partners with a self-proclaimed guru to open a co-working space, supervised by his sister Julia.
title: Entrepreneurs

overview: Rival lion prides in the Chobe River floodplains test the boundaries of their territories, assert dominance, hunt prey, and raise cubs. Each lion has a role—and personality—to observe, from the seasoned matriarch and master hunter to the nurturing aunt earning her keep and the young male forced out of the pride to grow into his own.
title: Into the Pride Lands

overview: In a new six-part series, Hanoch Daum will try to break the boundaries of political correctness and laugh at things that shouldn't be laughed at. In each episode, Hanoch went on a pastoral vacation outside the city with four people who all have a common denominator - some kind of disability or belonging to a group that the conversation about, and certainly the jokes about, are taboo. During the vacation he will have in-depth conversations with them and hear from their side what their lives are like. At the end of the vacation, he will perform a stand-up show, with the four participants with whom he spent time sitting in the front row.
title: טאבו

overview: Raiders of the Lost Art investigates works of art that were looted or stolen throughout history. Throughout history, some of the world's most amazing works of art have simply disappeared. Through re-enactment, rare archive, and expert comment we see how these treasures were looted, stolen or vanished into the archives. Some have been recovered but many more are still waiting to be found. The show is made in the UK by 3ddproductions & airs on freeview channel 'Yesterday'. In the US, it airs on channel 'Ovation'.
title: Raiders of the Lost Art

overview: They open doors that have long remained closed, often revealing a fierce storm brewing behind them. During intense sessions interspersed with challenges, deep-seated frustrations, unprocessed emotions, and unspoken thoughts finally surface. The couples confront each other and themselves in the hope of reconnecting.
title: Koppels in Crisis

overview: This gripping true crime docuseries unravel the elaborate plot that led to the untimely death of a 40 years old family man in Denmark
title: Hestepigen fra helvede

overview: Covering the people, transactions and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance.
title: Bloomberg Crypto

overview: Alina, a young beauty blogger, Zhenya, a teenage pranker, Vika, an excellent student, and Kolya, a 6-year-old True Edge fan who is always asking questions, are the Akimovs' four children. Like any kids their age, they dream of being alone at home, without the supervision of their dad and mom. But when their parents get stuck in Kamchatka because of a cloud of volcanic ash, the dream becomes a reality, and the apartment is gradually overgrown with pizza boxes and dirty dishes. How long will the joy of complete freedom last? Will children be able to cope with "adult" tasks — communicate with neighbors, defeat the flu epidemic, assemble furniture and (most importantly) return the missing Internet? And most importantly, will they miss their parents?
title: Одни дома

overview: The quiet town of Zarechny is shaken by a series of brutal murders. Investigator Yana returns home to solve the crime and overcome her inner demons. The girl's radical methods and personal interest endanger the investigation, and police Captain Denis joins the case. The trail leads the partners to a local orphanage. But the closer they get to the killer, the more they try to stop them. Someone is ready to do anything to keep a terrible secret forever in the past.
title: Отпечатки

overview: This drama is a human legal story centered on lawyer Otokita Hajime and detective Iseya Kai, who are partners both in their private lives and in work. Together, they take on divorce cases to help those suffering from a partner's betrayal. Their opponents are anything but ordinary; from a sleazy, high-profile TV host who assaults his junior female announcers behind his likable public image, to a so-called "fickle woman" who betrays her same-sex lover to marry someone of the opposite sex.
title: Your Divorce Is Served!

overview: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, especially when she's on a mission to murder. Deadly Women investigates the motives and modus operandi of female murderers. While males are often driven by anger, impulse and destruction, women usually have more complex, long-term reasons to kill. Through dramatized reconstructions the series investigates the driving force behind female thrill killers. What turns love affairs into fatal attractions. How twisted minds and dark secrets send other women on murdering rampages. Deadly Women also investigates the most ruthless female killers of them all-predators. Tune in as experts sift forensic fact from fanciful fiction. Former FBI agent and profiler, Candice DeLong offers insights into the psychology of female killers, while Dr Janis Amatuzio, a Mid West forensic pathologist known as "The Compassionate Coroner", provides expert commentary on the tell-tale evidence that Deadly Women leave behind. They are history's most intriguing and horrifying women. A sisterhood whose crimes are written in blood on history's pages.
title: Deadly Women

overview: Bromance is a 2015 Taiwanese romance, comedy television series starring Baron Chen, Megan Lai, Bii, Sean Lee and Yuan Chen as the main cast. Filming began on September 19, 2015 and will be filmed as it airs. First original broadcast began on October 18, 2015 on TTV airing every Sunday night at 10:00-11:30 pm. Could anyone be more excited to reach her 25th birthday? Pi Ya Nuo (Megan Lai) had an inauspicious start to her life. When she was born 25 years ago, her parents and extended family – along with their fortuneteller – eagerly awaited her arrival in the delivery room so that they could bless the beginning of the Pi family's heir. Upon hearing her first cry, the fortuneteller predicted on the spot that the baby boy would be a great success and a natural-born leader. But when the nurses announce that the baby is a girl, the stunned fortuneteller immediately announces that the girl would not survive her childhood unless she lives as a boy for the first 25 years of her life. Only then can Ya Nuo change her bad fate and bring prosperity to her family. On her 26th birthday, Ya Nuo can go back to her true gender without any repercussions. Doomed to live her life as a boy, Ya Nuo is shy and always tries to keep her distance to people to hide her true identity, and the mysterious aloofness makes her irresistible to the girls around her. One day, she accidentally helps out Du Zi Feng (Baron Chen), who happens to be a triad leader, and his sister, Du Zi Han (Mandy Tao). While Zi Han falls in love with Ya Nuo, Zi Feng becomes Ya Nuo's "sworn brother" and best friend. With her 26th birthday fast approaching, will Ya Nuo find her much-anticipated return to being a female will be as easy as she had hoped?
title: Bromance
Chong Sheng Ba Ling, Chuang Ye Cong Xiu En Ai Kai Ahi

overview: Focuses on the opportunities, risks & trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the ETF industry.
title: Bloomberg ETF IQ

overview: Talk show host Eva Jinek discusses the daily news and inspiring stories with a variety of guests.
title: Eva

overview: The harmony of a community is disrupted by an allegation of sexual assault on social media that names three teenagers as the culprits. The adults in charge of those mentioned, as aggressors and as victims, will have to deal with the tension of the situation and face their own relationship with sexuality. In the process they will discover that perhaps not only traditions are passed down from generation to generation, but also taboos and traumas.
title: Pubertat

overview: Talk show hosts Beau van Erven Dorens, Renze Klamer, and Humberto Tan bring current events to life in the new late-night program. They are joined by leading commentators who use their expertise to provide context and insight. In addition, there is also space for unexpected guests.
title: RTL Tonight

overview: BBC Wales takes two families on an epic journey back in time. Their destination: 19th century Snowdonia and a life of farming and quarrying that will test them to their limits.
title: Snowdonia 1890

overview: Talk show hosts Jeroen Pauw or Tim de Wit discuss the topic of the day with various guests.
title: Pauw & De Wit

overview: The all-new Healthy, Wealthy & Wise is coming soon to the Seven Network, featuring TV and radio royalty Chrissie Swan as host. Chrissie will be joined by a fresh team of expert presenters, handpicked from Australia's best content creators, and many of the segments from the beloved 1990s hit – including food, home, money, health and travel – are set to return, with a very 2025 twist.
title: Healthy, Wealthy & Wise

overview: Together with a regular sidekick, Sven Kockelmann takes viewers on a journey through developments in The Hague and puts politicians on the spot. Main players and opinion leaders in The Hague join him to look back and ahead at the debates, corridors, and storylines of politics.
title: Café Kockelmann

overview: Summer talk show focusing on the topic of the day. Talk show hosts Sam Hagens and Welmoed Sijtsma discuss current topics and relevant debates with guests.
title: Goedenavond Nederland

overview: When Suga, the president of a notorious motorcycle club, is unexpectedly released from prison he is confronted with the betrayal of his brothers and must now fight for his life and that of his family.
title: SUGA: Ride or Die

overview: Following Britain's police as they head out to clean up the streets.
title: Street Cops: Catching the Yobs

overview: The story of Chelyabinsk shashlik maker Pasha, who, together with his father and son Kostya, went south to inherit half of a winery. The other half belongs to the aesthete winemaker, a fanatic of his craft, Sergey Gordeev, his daughter Oksana and granddaughter Mila. In order to save their common business from collapse, representatives of two different families will have to become partners. But how can they do this when for Sergey wine is art, and for Pasha it is "tasteless sourness"?
title: Виноделы

overview: Shortly before the collapse of the USSR, Marina and Ivan Happy have triplets and begin life in the long-awaited separate apartment number 13. But the hungry 90s are coming, and the mood in the family is no longer rosy. Ivan, a young and promising candidate of sciences, is forced to become a tutor while Marina earns money on the market. And then 2012 comes, filled with the energy of a new time. How to start a life from scratch, build a career, and most importantly, win back the love of a wife whose feelings are clouded by domestic problems, innuendos, and old grudges? The pain of losing one of the children still makes itself felt, as does the mystery of the death of Ivan's mistress, Raisa, who lived next door. Will the Happy Ones be able to find happiness again, and will Raisa's daughter be able to find out the truth 13 years after her mother's death?
title: Время Счастливых

overview: French and Saunders is a British sketch comedy television series written by and starring comic duo Dawn French and Jennifer Saunders that ran from 9 March 1987 – 24 December 2007. Widely popular in the late 1980s and the early 1990s, the show was given one of the highest budgets in BBC history to create detailed spoofs and satires of popular culture, movies, celebrities and art.
title: French and Saunders

overview: In this opinion and current affairs program, reporters and opinion makers from De Telegraaf and Hart van Nederland discuss the news that the Netherlands is talking about.
title: Nieuws van de Dag

overview: Memphis to the Mountain follows a determined group of young climbers from one of South Memphis's most overlooked and hard-edged neighborhoods—where climbing is virtually unknown—as they set out to conquer a 16,000-foot rock tower on Mt. Kenya. Over the course of a year, they endure grueling preparation, training alongside some of the sport's most renowned figures, including Alex Honnold and Philip Henderson. Battling thin air, raw fear, and the limits of their own endurance, they come to realize that the hardest climb isn't the mountain—it's transforming who you believe you can be. A story of grit, transformation, and the unshakable power of reaching beyond what you thought possible.
title: Memphis to the Mountain

overview: Victims of romance scams try to reclaim their lives with help from "The Tinder Swindler" target Cecilie Fjellhøy and private investigator Brianne Joseph.
title: Love Con Revenge
I Meet Him Againe at the Corner
Xiao Li Jing Ta Dai Zhe Ling Zhu Shen Qi Hui Lai Le

overview: A documentary that follows comedian Alan Davies around the United Kingdom during his 1999 tour and exploring the nature of stand-up comedy.
title: Stand Up with Alan Davies

overview: Iskender was a feared gangster in the dark alleys of Istanbul, known for his own rough code of honor — until betrayal left him bleeding and stripped of everything he had built. When he opens his eyes in a quiet Aegean town, he finds himself surrounded by warmth he has never known: a caring mother, a blind little sister, a home that feels like it was always his. The townspeople believe he is Kamil, a long-lost son returned; only he knows the truth. But the past never lets go — old enemies, blood feuds, and the ghosts of his choices haunt him still. As he uncovers a shocking secret — that this family is bound to him by blood — Iskender stands at a crossroads. Revenge or redemption? Will he remain the ruthless survivor the streets created, or dare to become the man he was meant to be? This is a story of love, betrayal, and the price of becoming truly human.
title: Cennetin Çocukları

overview: In Japan's newest medical specialty, general practitioner Tokushige Akira listens closely to his patients' stories, uncovering hidden truths and guiding them toward healing through empathy and conversation.
title: The 19th Medical Chart

overview: The Jackal (Aurora Leone, Ciro Priello, Fabio Balsamo, and Gianluca Fru) take us to Cape Town, South Africa, where they offer humorous, sarcastic, and unfiltered commentary on the adventures of a group of young people during their extraordinary vacation. Breathtaking locations set the stage for a series of extraordinary events that will leave an unforgettable mark on the participants.
title: Holiday Crush

overview: A kind-hearted gay man buys a house to fulfill his love? A middle schooler buys a parent? The strange life of three people connected at the "edges of society."
title: Our Home

overview: Offers unprecedented insight into the motivations and disturbing relationship between former mommy vlogger Ruby Franke and rogue therapist Jodi Hildebrandt.
title: Ruby & Jodi: A Cult of Sin and Influence

overview: The inspired biography of sociologist Herbert de Souza, Betinho, reminds us of his struggle to combat hunger and provide access to social justice for the poor.
title: Betinho: no fio da navalha

overview: Legendary Goblins and Gumiho appear in 21st-century Seoul, Getting tangled with them, everything start to go wrong! The almighty Goblin King and the soft, squishy aspiring actor a tingling, electrifying romance fantasy begins!
title: The Story of Bihyung: Enchanted Master of the Goblin

overview: Fresh off their breakout on Season 17 of RuPaul's Drag Race, fan-favorite couple Kori King and Lydia B Kollins are taking audiences straight into their bed in Pillow Talk with Butt King. The series follows the drag duo as they spill behind-the-scenes secrets from Drag Race, answer compelling fan questions, and reveal the messy, hilarious, and heartfelt truths of building a relationship in the spotlight. Will there be laughter, confusion, chaos and mess? Well, yes! It's Pillow Talk with Butt King!
title: Pillow Talk with Butt King

overview: The illegitimate son of the Lu family, Lu Huaifeng, is hunted down and saved by Song Xia. He ends up falling in love with her at first sight. Song Xia's adoptive parents are killed by Lu family's eldest son, Lu Xuan, in a hit and run, and the Lu family covers it up. Lu Huaifeng conceals the truth and keeps her by his side. After learning the truth, Song Xia feigns amnesia to take revenge, obtaining evidence of Lu Xuan's crimes, triggering internal strife. Lu Xuan kills his father and is arrested. When Lu Huaifeng tries to stop him, he is shot and loses his memory. Upon reunion, he does not recognize her.
title: That's Not Love

overview: Konghou, the scorned princess of a fallen kingdom, accidentally crosses into the world of immortal cultivation. Suddenly, she finds herself the center of attention, from her master and seniors to neighboring sects. The entire realm adores her. To toughen herself up, she voluntarily leaves this comfort zone and embarks on a journey. She soon meets a frail young man named Huai Zong. They team up to adventure through the cultivation world. To her astonishment, he is the legendary genius and the very author of the cultivation novels she obsesses over. Konghou successfully brings her favorite author back to her sect as her husband, and together, through countless trials, they conquer their inner demons, achieve breakthroughs, and become revered Grand Masters of their generation.
title: Flying Up Without Disturb

overview: Ten Norwegians fight against both the wild jungle and their own impulses when wild temptations distract them from their goal - a prize pool of 2.5 million kroner.
title: Ville fristelser

overview: Explore the community of Littledale, where things are messy and dreams are duct-taped together and barely hanging on.
title: Littledale

overview: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...
title: The Early Spring

overview: When innocent country boy, Dongha, shows up at a mysterious vampire house, his life takes a thrilling turn.
title: My Secret Vampire

overview: A spin-off to The Real Housewives of New Jersey, the series features Albie and Chris Manzo, the sons of full-time cast member of RHONJ Caroline Manzo, living independently away from home with their housemate Gregg Bennett, in Hoboken, New Jersey.
title: Boys to Manzo

overview: A spin-off to The Real Housewives of Miami, the series features Elsa Patton, the mother of full-time cast member of RHOM Marysol Patton, embarking on launching her own coffee line, also titled Havana Elsa.
title: Havana Elsa

overview: Murray is a nice guy. Everyone thinks so. He is good to his friends, kind to his colleagues, treats his staff well. He's a top bloke. So no one is more surprised than Murray when his wife Bex walks out on their marriage. On her 40th birthday, at her surprise party. Murray is confused. What's he done wrong? Where's she gone? Is she coming back?
title: I Want My Wife Back

overview: In the Far Eastern village of Chernovka, surrounded by taiga and swamps, an emergency occurs: a sawmill burns down, and in the morning, bodies charred beyond recognition are found there. A young investigator, Evgeniya Rakitina, arrives from the regional center. Local authorities and the villagers themselves are trying in every way to hush up the case, writing it off as an accident, but Evgeniya's professional instincts tell her that something is fishy here. And the deeper the heroine delves into this case, the more she understands: the people here are connected to each other by more than just family ties. Having compared the testimonies of witnesses, she concludes that she will have to look for the solution to the mystery in the past.
title: Здесь все свои

overview: Тиха Нава is the first Ukrainian true crime series, set in a small town of the same name. The main character is a young lawyer who accidentally finds himself at the centre of an investigation into a series of brutal crimes. On his way to the truth, he encounters the indifference of society, the silent consent of those around him, and the inertia of the system.
title: Тиха Нава

overview: The world's top-ranked players take the court in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia for a star-studded tennis showcase with ultimate bragging rights on the line.
title: Six Kings Slam

overview: Josh Brolin narrates an intimate look at Canelo Álvarez and Terence Crawford's preparations and lives before their historic super middleweight clash.
title: Countdown: Canelo vs. Crawford

overview: Deprived of her mother's attention and love throughout her life, Seniha grows up with a deep sense of jealousy towards her older brother, Halit. For her beauty-obsessed mother, Seniha is the ugly duckling, completely unfit for her noble and wealthy family. Her older brother, Halit, is the opposite. He is her mother's pride in every sense. Halit attends the best schools and takes advantage of the family's resources. He becomes both the country's most successful lawyer and its most promiscuous bachelor. Seniha, however, sinks deeper and deeper into the depths of her sense of worthlessness. She never finished school, never married, and has practically become a servant in her own home. She has become, as her older brother calls her, "Miss Nobody."
title: Kıskanmak

overview: Kobe Ilsen and Danira Boukhriss Terkessidis take a closer look at our health.
title: Over mijn lijf

overview: After a difficult childhood with a father who was falsely accused and an absent mother, Jeong-won, now an adult, begins living as the "fake Yeong-chae" at the suggestion of her old friend Yeong-chae at a gathering of rich families. One day, Yeong-chae tries to escape to Paris to avoid an arranged marriage and asks Jeong-won to stand in for her for a month. Living as the "fake Yeong-chae," Jeong-won grows close to Se-hun, the heir to the Jinseong Group. Amidst this, Jeong-won discovers that Yeong-chae stole her designs to achieve success, and that her future mother-in-law is her biological mother. Jeong-won resolves to become the real Yeong-chae and reclaim her life.
title: A Graceful Liar

overview: When a voice phishing scam destroys her family, struggling actress So Min dives into the underworld of deepfake technology to seek revenge. Armed with forged identities and nothing to lose, she infiltrates a powerful crime syndicate—crossing paths with a power-hungry boss, a conflicted cop, and a charmingly dangerous hacker. But as the lies stack up, the question remains: will she bring them down, or be consumed by the very deception she wields?
title: No Mercy

overview: Your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.
title: Bloomberg: The China Show

overview: Alice Bell is a former nurse, and also the lover, and accomplice, of a notorious anaesthetist serial killer. She is presently living in Britain under a new identity. When, online, Fran Da Silva is accused of being Alice Bell, her happy family life implodes in a wave of mob hate. Then she discovers she's not the only woman to suffer this fate. Fran and the other accused women band together to fight back and clear their names. But as they battle to prove their innocence, what if one of the group is lying - and is the real Alice Bell…?
title: Hunting Alice Bell

overview: Chief Inspector Peter Ledecký and his colleagues face the darkest sides of human nature on a daily basis. There is no room for heroism in their work - victories are silent, accompanied by fatigue and frustration. They fight not only murderers, but also a system in which the rules only apply to one side.
title: Neuer

overview: The plot is based on the famous urban legend about a girl named Zoe who stood with an icon of St. Nicholas the Wonderworker in 1956.
title: Зоя

overview: A once‑promising university soccer talent, Seung‑hyun, sidelined by injury, visits a futsal court for rehabilitation. Through personalized training with his dedicated therapist, Ji‑sung, and heartfelt chats on the "Kick‑in" app, both body and soul find healing—and an unexpected love blossoms on the field.
title: Kick in Love

overview: A successful businessman returns to sell an old building and unexpectedly reunites with his former lover. As they navigate shared memories and unresolved emotions, the past slowly begins to surface — and so does the possibility of a second chance.
title: You Are My Present

overview: Flowers is a comedy about an eccentric family, the Flowers, struggling to hold themselves together. Maurice (author of twisted children's books The Grubbs) and Deborah are a husband and wife who are barely together but yet to divorce.
title: Flowers

overview: Born into a chaotic, hell-raising and deeply tight-knit family, Saraya learned to never back down from a challenge. She's a rule breaker and drawn to people with this same audacious mentality. Inspired by the honesty of "Dumb Blonde," the unapologetic nature of "Cancelled," and the humor and charm of "Chicken Shop Date," "Rulebreakers" will go beyond the world of wrestling and feature Saraya and guests participating in pranks and on-set mischief while exploring the good, the bad, and the ugly of their lives. Saraya will also release solo episodes monthly on which she'll explore her singular life and road to stardom and personal topics like what it's like to be a woman in wrestling, her journey to veganism, loving someone in prison, and more.
title: Rulebreakers With Saraya

overview: India is a country of vivid contrasts: billionaire's luxurious mansions and slums, IT giants' offices and ancient rituals, Bollywood and sacred Varanasi. Alla Mikheeva and blogger Lorenzo Bagnati embark on a long journey through "Forbidden India" to show it as the inhabitants themselves see it — diverse and unpredictable.
title: Запретная Индия
